name: xX_DarkAngel_Xx
about: poet. night creature. i write verses about the void and comment them on people's pages whether they ask or not. my heart has been broken 7 times and each time it grew back glitterier. do NOT message me before sundown.

interests.General: writing poetry in eyeliner, 11:11 wishes, glitter that stays on for days (a metaphor), thunderstorms from the porch, black candles from hot topic, the moon (mine. see starxgazer.)
interests.Music: my chemical romance (three cheers is a diary), AFI, evanescence, the used, HIM, dashboard confessional when the wound is fresh, one violin note over rain sounds (my song)
interests.Movies: the crow, edward scissorhands, interview with the vampire, donnie darko (i understood it. don't ask me to explain it), the nightmare before christmas, obviously
interests.Television: invader zim (gir is my heart), daria, buffy (spike era), the addams family reruns at 2am
interests.Books: the raven, anything by anne rice, sylvia plath's journals, my own journal (unpublished, too raw), the perks of being a wallflower, coraline
interests.Heroes: the moon, edgar allan poe, gerard way, patrick (the only pure thing), whoever invented waterproof mascara (a poet, surely)

hometown: the abyss (cleveland, ohio. the abyss has a cleveland.)

bulletins.subject: ~*~ a poem for the newcomers ~*~
bulletins.body: fifteen candles flicker in the dark of the friend request queue / your profiles load slowly, like grief, or dial-up / welcome to the beautiful wreckage we call home / leave a comment. leave a scar. leave your top 8 open for me. / (repost this at 11:11 or don't. the void reposts nothing, and look how mysterious it is.) xX
